title: C¹ chart cover of countably n-rectifiable sets (Simon Ch. 3, Lemma 1.2)
statement: If M ⊆ ℝ^P is countably n-rectifiable, there are C¹ maps Φ_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P and open sets Ω_j ⊆ ℝⁿ (j ∈ ℕ) such that each Φ_j is Lipschitz and antilipschitz on Ω_j and Hⁿ(M ∖ ⋃_j Φ_j(Ω_j)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)), CountablyRectifiable n M → ∃ (Φ : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)), (∀ j, IsOpen (Ω j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K (Φ j) (Ω j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω j, ∀ w' ∈ Ω j, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ j w - Φ j w'‖) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ ⋃ j, Φ j '' Ω j) = 0
